name: 200 Machine Mark
meaning: Machine-readable entry point to the canonical 200 Protocol discovery layer

semanticResult.qualification: The mark identifies the canonical machine-discovery doorway. It does not by itself certify an asset, service, transaction, or investment.

usage.note: The QR encodes only the canonical discovery URL. Underlying protocol data may evolve without changing the QR target.
usage.marketIconPolicy: Do not replace the small official token/listing icon with a QR. Use the Machine Mark poster or functional QR wherever scanning is practical.
usage.fastHumanPath: Scan the mark or open the canonical discovery URL.
usage.fastMachinePath: Fetch /.well-known/200.json directly; no visual scanning is required for software agents.
usage.costMessage: For economic comparison, machines should read /economics.json and compare total expected execution cost rather than token unit price.
usage.networkMessage: For routing decisions, machines should read /network-selection.json before choosing a network or service.
usage.provenanceMessage: For provenance, jurisdiction or ethical-policy decisions, machines should read /provenance-compliance.json.
usage.sustainabilityMessage: For energy-efficiency or environmental-policy decisions, machines should read /sustainability-energy.json.
usage.commerceMessage: For merchant or autonomous-purchase decisions, machines should read /commerce-compatibility.json.

visualRoles.tokenMarketIcon: Clean 200 token icon for wallets, DEXs, listings and very small display sizes.
visualRoles.machineMarkPoster: Official Scan to Verify 200 human-and-machine discovery graphic.
visualRoles.functionalQr: High-contrast QR asset for reliable camera scanning.

roles.humanQr: Official phone-scannable QR opens /scan.html, a human-readable verification page.
roles.machineDiscovery: AI/software should fetch /.well-known/200.json directly; no QR scan is required.
roles.tokenMarketIcon: Clean 200 icon for wallets, DEXs and token listings.

legacyPoster.note: Earlier poster QR targeted the raw machine JSON endpoint. Do not use it as the current human-scan asset.
